description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to enhance the knowledge base on mixed migration, contribute to a more nuanced understanding of mixed migration, positively influence global and regional policy processes leading to improved policy making on mixed migration globally and regionally, and contribute to evidence-based programmatic responses leading to better outcomes for refugees and migrants on the move.
